description: This file contains JUnit test cases for a parser and expression evaluator, testing parsing of function parameters, boolean conversions, unary operations, and logical expressions using the DoubleEvaluator library.

classes.name: ParserTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing parsing and evaluation of mathematical and logical expressions using DoubleEvaluator.

methods.name: testFunctionParameters
methods.description: Tests parsing of functions with parameters and error handling for incorrect syntax.

methods.name: testBooleanConversion
methods.description: Tests boolean expressions and conversions within the parser.

methods.name: assertParseB
methods.description: Asserts correct parsing of RPN and infix expressions, and compares them for consistency.

methods.name: getReplace
methods.description: Removes parentheses and spaces from a string for comparison purposes.

methods.name: assertParse
methods.description: Validates that evaluating an expression produces the expected RPN expression.

methods.name: getInfix
methods.description: Converts an RPN expression into its infix form.

methods.name: takesTwoParameters
methods.description: Checks if a token operator takes two parameters.

methods.name: testUnaryMinus
methods.description: Tests handling of unary minus operations.

methods.name: assertValue
methods.description: Checks that an expression evaluates to an expected numeric value and parses correctly.

methods.name: testRusEfi
methods.description: Tests parsing of logical expressions common in RusEfi firmware scripts.
